title: EmberTrace data/meta.json (H2)
description: Dataset facts served by GET /api/meta (API spec section 4). Written by pipeline/export.py (CAL-4). Draft by Person 1; Person 2 to confirm (CAL-1).

data_kind.description: synthetic when the input came from tools/synthetic (SYNTHETIC.txt marker)

pipeline_version.description: Labels the state of the values, e.g. 0.1-calibration-pending until the stage 5-7 zero-to-positive issue is fixed

data_through.description: Last day with VIIRS data; decides whether the last month is partial

provisional_from.description: First near-real-time month; null if none

grid_extent.description: Outer edges of the cells in cell_month (centres +/- cell_size_deg / 2)
